You control the active arm of a simulated da Vinci surgical robot. Task: PSM2 (the right arm) starts with an open gripper. Move PSM2's gripper to a grasping point on the suturing needle lying on the tissue phantom and close the jaw to grasp it.
Each turn you get the offset from the gripper to the target (target minus gripper). Output actions that cancel it.
Actions:
move(dx, dy, dz)             # millimetres, at most 20 per axis
rotate(droll, dpitch, dyaw)  # roll/pitch/yaw in degrees, at most 30 per axis
gripper(open) / gripper(close)
Up to 3 actions per turn, separated by '|'. Larger values are clipped, so a far target takes several turns.
Success: within 5 mm and 30 deg of the target with the jaw closed. Close the gripper in the turn whose motion reaches the target.
